title: Tower
html_source:
Referring to the now-famous Martello tower in Sandycove, a seaside resort in Dublin, where Joyce himself lived for a time as a young man. Indeed, his stay at the tower inspired the beginning chapters of Ulysses.

The actual tower is now home to a museum dedicated to the history of James Joyce, and houses a number of artifacts and pieces of memorabilia relating to the author’s work.

The tower overlooking Sandycove
